verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents Smart Retries, which automatically retry failed subscription and invoice payments to prevent involuntary churn. Its recovery analytics report failure and recovery rates, which covers the measurable-recovery part of the story. The evidence does not describe how the retry cadence is optimized, whether by ML or a configurable schedule, so that core element is unproven. Missing for 10: documented ML- or schedule-optimized retry timing, quantified recovery outcomes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, failed renewal payments are retried automatically on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence that measurably recovers involuntary churn

citations.quote: Smart Retries: Automatically retry failed payments to prevent involuntary churn due to temporary issues.
Stripe Billing can automatically retry failed subscription and invoice payments for you.
Recovery analytics: Analyze subscription payment failure rates, recovery rates, and recent failed payments for top customers.
